rules: Platforms, laws, helplines and statistics are real and were checked on the date above.
People, posts and case URLs are fictional. Case URLs use example paths or the reserved .example domain.
Case timings are illustrative, taken from the app's demo script, not measured platform performance.
Never show a real person, a real post URL, or any intimate image in a demo.
